Elaine K: heads-up — Friday 3pm panel looks tight. 4 back-to-back interviews. Candidate has a small live demo; they'll need a USB-C->HDMI dongle and a USB key with test data. Can someone confirm device checkout and AV room access? Also quick rubric q: do we stick with 50/50 design vs execution or follow hiring doc (40/60)?
Sam K: I can cover AV and bring a dongle. Which room is this?
Priya S: Zoom link is https://zoom.us/j/123456789 — calendar invite updated. Room is B-3 but I need someone to confirm AV cart pickup.
DevEx: quick rubric note — for this role we usually use rubric v2 (link: https://redwood.co/rubrics/v2). The debrief form asks for: score (1-5), top signal, and neutral comments. Please fill in the score reason.
Recruiter Bot: Reminder created — interview debrief due within 24 hours after interview ends. I'll ping the panel 23 hours after.
Elaine K: thanks @Sam K — B-3 it is. @Sam K can you grab the cart from Tech Ops at 2:30pm? I'll update the invite to show you as AV owner.
Priya S: re: weighting — after talking to hiring manager we should treat design/execution as equal for this hire. So 50/50. I'll add a note in the rubric doc with 2 quick anchors (needs work / meets / exceeds) for the design section.
Sam K: confirmed. I'll be there at 2:20 with dongle + spare laptop. Happy to scribe if no one else volunteers.
Elaine K: if you scribe, please add a 1-line signal at top: technical_strength, communication_clarity, decision_quality. That helps hiring manager skim.
DevEx: TL;DR for anyone jumping in: Room B-3 reserved, Sam owns AV & scribe unless swapped, rubric weight = 50/50, debrief form link: https://redwood.co/debriefs/submit?int=1759998888 — submit within 24h. :thumbsup: 
Recruiter Bot: Note: candidate consent for recording confirmed.
Elaine K: perfect — thanks everyone. If any last-minute swaps ping here and I'll reassign the invite.
